view.stem: 一个两位数的两个数字的平方和是 $65$。这个数加上 $27$ 后，得到由相同两个数字组成、十位与个位交换的两位数。原来的数是多少？

intent.task: Interpret the same two digits as reversal and preserve original versus reversed number roles.
intent.source_solution: For tens u and units v, 10u+v+27=10v+u gives v-u=3. u^2+v^2=65 then gives u=4,v=7; the other root has negative digits.
intent.unit_reason: The whole original number combines place value, reversal and square sum; no separate digit clicks.
limitations: Independent digit-equation modeling and invalid-root exclusion are deferred.

rationales.derivation: 4^2+7^2=65 and 47+27=74, its reversal.
Find 47+27=74 but report the number after addition rather than the original.
rationales.misconception: Exchange original and reversed-number roles.

rationales.derivation: Recognize 65=1^2+8^2 and take digits 1,8 without applying the reversal equation.
rationales.misconception: Use only the square-sum decomposition; 18+27=45 does not reverse the digits.

view.stem: 两名骑车人同时从相距 $28\text{ km}$ 的 $A$、$B$ 两地出发，相向而行，$1$ 小时后相遇。全程保持各自速度，从 $A$ 出发的人到达 $B$ 比从 $B$ 出发的人到达 $A$ 晚 $35$ 分钟。两人的速度分别是多少？

options.text: 从 $A$ 出发者 $16\text{ km/h}$，从 $B$ 出发者 $12\text{ km/h}$。
从 $A$ 出发者 $12\text{ km/h}$，从 $B$ 出发者 $16\text{ km/h}$。
从 $A$ 出发者 $14\text{ km/h}$，从 $B$ 出发者 $14\text{ km/h}$。

intent.task: Combine meeting speed sum with directed full-route arrival difference in consistent units.
intent.source_solution: u+v=28 and 28/u-28/v=7/12 give u=12 or 112; positivity rejects 112 with v=-84. Thus A rider 12,B rider 16 km/h.
intent.unit_reason: The two role-assigned speeds constitute one whole travel result; their order is essential.
limitations: Independent travel modeling, minute-to-hour conversion and invalid speed rejection are deferred.

rationales.derivation: Find speed magnitudes 12,16 but assign the faster speed to the rider stated to arrive later.
rationales.misconception: Reverse the directed arrival-time relation.

rationales.derivation: 12+16=28; 28/12-28/16=7/12 h=35 min, with the A rider later.
Split the meeting speed sum equally, 28/2=14, for both riders.
rationales.misconception: Use the meeting condition only and neglect the unequal full-route arrival times.

view.stem: 两列火车同时从相距 $45\text{ km}$ 的 $M$、$N$ 两站相向开出，$20$ 分钟后相遇。全程保持各自速度，从 $M$ 出发的列车到达 $N$ 比另一列车到达 $M$ 早 $9$ 分钟。两列车的速度分别是多少？

options.text: 从 $M$ 出发者 $60\text{ km/h}$，从 $N$ 出发者 $75\text{ km/h}$。
从 $M$ 出发者 $67.5\text{ km/h}$，从 $N$ 出发者 $67.5\text{ km/h}$。
从 $M$ 出发者 $75\text{ km/h}$，从 $N$ 出发者 $60\text{ km/h}$。

intent.task: Keep station roles, meeting interval and directed full-route arrival times distinct.
intent.source_solution: p+q=135 and 45/q-45/p=3/20 give q=60 or 675. Positivity rejects 675 with p=-540. M train 75,N train 60 km/h.
intent.unit_reason: One assigned speed pair captures the entire travel problem and its units.
limitations: Independently writing the speed/time system, unit conversion and invalid-root check is deferred.

rationales.derivation: Find magnitudes 75,60 but give 60 to the M train, reversing which train arrives first.
rationales.misconception: Reverse the station-specific arrival order.

rationales.derivation: From 45/(20/60)=135 divide the combined speed equally: 135/2=67.5.
rationales.misconception: Ignore the 9-minute arrival difference and assume equal speeds.

view.stem: 两根水管同时注水，$12$ 分钟可灌满水箱。先用一根灌半箱，再用另一根灌半箱，共用 $25$ 分钟。每根水管单独灌满一整箱分别需要多久？

intent.task: Distinguish individual full-tank times, sequential half-tank times and combined rates.
intent.source_solution: Full-tank times t,s>0 obey 1/t+1/s=1/12 and (t+s)/2=25, giving t+s=50,ts=600 and times 20,30 min.
intent.unit_reason: The unordered pair of full-job times is one coherent rate task.
limitations: Independent rate modeling and quadratic solving are deferred.

rationales.derivation: Find full-tank times 20,30 but report their halves 10,15, which are the sequential half-tank durations.
rationales.misconception: Confuse half-job durations with the requested individual full-job times.

rationales.derivation: Assign the joint filling duration 12 min to each individual pipe.
rationales.misconception: Treat combined performance as each pipe's individual performance.

view.stem: 两台收割机合作，$35$ 小时能收完同一块地。较快的一台单独完成，比另一台少用 $24$ 小时。两台单独完成分别需要多久？

options.text: 较快者 $84$ 小时，较慢者 $60$ 小时。
较快者 $60$ 小时，较慢者 $84$ 小时。
较快者 $35$ 小时，较慢者 $59$ 小时。

intent.task: Use reciprocal work rates, directed time difference and positive durations.
intent.source_solution: Fast time t>0, slow t+24; 1/t+1/(t+24)=1/35 gives t^2-46t-840=0, t=60 or -14. Reject -14; times 60,84 h.
intent.unit_reason: One role-assigned time pair is the whole work-rate answer.
limitations: Independent rate equation production and negative-time rejection are deferred.

rationales.derivation: Find durations 60,84 but report 84 for the faster machine.
rationales.misconception: Associate greater completion time with faster work.

rationales.derivation: Give the faster machine the joint time 35, then add 24 for the slower machine to obtain 59.
rationales.misconception: Confuse joint full-job time with the fast machine's individual full-job time.

view.stem: 对方程 $x^2+3xy+y^2=41$，判断 $(5,1)$、$(1,5)$ 是否为解，并判断任意一个解交换坐标后是否仍为解。哪项结论及理由成立？

options.text: 两个数对都是解；任意解 $(a,b)$ 交换后，只有 $a=b$ 时才仍为解，因为交换必须保留数对本身。
只有 $(5,1)$ 是解；交换后左边变成 $b^2+3b^2+a^2$，所以不能把一个解的坐标任意交换。
两个数对都是解；交换后左边 $b^2+3ba+a^2=a^2+3ab+b^2$，所以任意解交换后仍为解。

intent.task: Cover both named substitutions and recognize the general symmetry proof, not infer universality from two examples.
intent.source_solution: F(5,1)=25+15+1=41 and F(1,5)=1+15+25=41. For all real a,b, F(b,a)=b^2+3ba+a^2=a^2+3ab+b^2=F(a,b), proving the implication.
intent.unit_reason: Finite checks and the universal coordinate-swap claim form one coherent symmetry task; the option contains a mathematical argument, not a truth-combination code.
limitations: Recognizing an identity-based argument is not independently writing the requested general proof.
The source general proof-writing production task remains deferred.

rationales.derivation: Verify both named pairs, then require (b,a)=(a,b) as a condition for remaining a solution; equality of pairs forces a=b.
rationales.misconception: Confuse equality to the original pair with membership in the same equation's solution set; (5,1) is already a counterexample.

rationales.derivation: Replace the swapped product ba by b^2. For original a=5,b=1 the supposed swapped value is 1+3+25=29, leading to rejection of (1,5).
rationales.misconception: Replace a product of different coordinates by the square of one coordinate when swapping.

rationales.derivation: Both substitutions total 41, and commutativity of addition and multiplication gives the displayed identity for arbitrary a,b, not only these examples.

view.stem: 下列数对中，选出所有满足方程 $x^2+xy+y^2=29$ 的实数数对 $(x,y)$。

intent.task: Judge both original radical pairs by exact substitution, especially the mixed product.
intent.source_solution: Original a has squared terms 12,3 and product 6, total 21, so is not a solution. Original b has sum 6 and product 7, giving (x+y)^2-xy=36-7=29, so is a solution.
intent.unit_reason: Native selection of qualifying pairs preserves the shared equation without per-expression clicks or combination-code answers.
limitations: Selecting pairs does not demonstrate independently writing the two exact radical computations.

rationales.derivation: This candidate is the mandatory original source pair, not a generated numeric distractor. A domain-only test checks 12>=0 and 3>=0 and accepts it without substitution; the actual substitution is 12+sqrt(36)+3=21, not 29.
rationales.misconception: Confuse real-domain admissibility with satisfying the equation: check only that the two supplied square roots exist, then accept the pair without evaluating the left side.

rationales.derivation: xy=(3+sqrt(2))(3-sqrt(2))=7 and x+y=6, so the left side is 36-7=29.
Choose squared magnitudes 12 and 29-12=17 while neglecting xy; the actual total is 29+sqrt(204)>29.
rationales.misconception: Solve x^2+y^2=29 instead of the stated equation containing xy.

rationales.derivation: Negate the y coordinate of the conjugate pair, retaining squared sum 22 but changing xy from 7 to -7; total becomes 15.
rationales.misconception: Assume changing one coordinate's sign preserves an expression because its squared terms are unchanged.

view.stem: 下列数对中，选出所有满足实数方程 $\sqrt{x}-\sqrt{y}=1$ 的数对 $(x,y)$。根号表示非负平方根。

intent.task: Recognize two distinct solutions while respecting both radicand domains and the principal-root difference.
intent.source_solution: x,y>=0; for t=sqrt(y)>=0, all solutions are ((t+1)^2,t^2). Taking t=0,1 gives (1,0),(4,1).
intent.unit_reason: Selection of complete candidate pairs is one equation-level task, not separate values or blank clicks. It supplies two distinct recognized solutions without claiming construction.
limitations: Does not demonstrate generating the requested arbitrary two solutions independently.
General solution production and original written solution generation remain deferred.

rationales.derivation: Both radicands are nonnegative and sqrt(1)-sqrt(0)=1.
Square the difference incorrectly as x-y=1; choose y=1 and x=2. Actually sqrt(2)-1≠1.
rationales.misconception: Treat the square of a difference of square roots as the difference of their squares.

rationales.derivation: sqrt(4)-sqrt(1)=2-1=1 with nonnegative radicands.
Use the false squared condition x-y=1, set x=0 and y=-1, and fail to check the original radicands.
rationales.misconception: Combine an invalid squaring rule with omission of the y>=0 domain restriction.

view.stem: 下列数对中，选出所有满足实数方程 $\sqrt{x+y}-\sqrt{y}=1$ 的数对 $(x,y)$。根号表示非负平方根。

intent.task: Recognize two full solution pairs while enforcing y>=0 and x+y>=0.
intent.source_solution: For t=sqrt(y)>=0, sqrt(x+y)=t+1 gives x=2t+1,y=t^2. Taking t=2,3 gives (5,4),(7,9); both radicands must be nonnegative.
intent.unit_reason: Whole candidate pairs preserve the coupled radicands and provide two distinct recognized examples without atomizing the equation. Parameters 2,3 avoid repeating a correct candidate from the other radical task.
limitations: Selecting supplied pairs is not generating the source's arbitrary two solutions.
Independent written solution generation remains deferred.

rationales.derivation: Square the difference incorrectly to (x+y)-y=1, infer x=1, and choose y=4. Actual difference sqrt(5)-2≠1.
rationales.misconception: Treat the square of a difference as the difference of squares.

rationales.derivation: y=4 and x+y=9 are nonnegative; sqrt(9)-sqrt(4)=3-2=1.
Use the false squared condition x=1 and allow y=-1 because x+y=0 is nonnegative, forgetting the separate sqrt(y).
rationales.misconception: Check only the combined radicand while omitting y>=0, after invalid squaring.

rationales.derivation: y=9 and x+y=16 are in domain; sqrt(16)-sqrt(9)=4-3=1.

view.stem: 不作图，判断 $y=x^2+4$、$y=9-x^2$、$xy=6$、$xy=-12$ 的图像经过哪些象限，并区分坐标轴上的点。下列哪张表完全正确？表中的象限不包含坐标轴。

intent.task: Compare all four equations by sign and distinguish open quadrants from axis points without graphing.
intent.source_solution: x^2+4>0 gives I,II and (0,4). 9-x^2 is positive for |x|<3 and negative outside, so all four quadrants, axis points (±3,0),(0,9). xy=6 requires matching signs, I,III; xy=-12 requires opposite signs, II,IV; neither meets an axis.
intent.unit_reason: One complete sign/axis table retains the shared comparison and every boundary case rather than turning table cells into clicks.
limitations: Choosing a completed table does not demonstrate independently writing the sign analysis for each equation.

rationales.derivation: Apply the stated sign intervals and product-sign rules; at x=0 the ordinates are 4,9, and the second equation alone has x-axis roots ±3.
Replace y=9-x^2 by y=sqrt(9-x^2), giving only I,II, x intercepts ±3 and y intercept 3; leave the other equations unchanged.
rationales.misconception: Insert an unstated square root, restricting domain and sign and changing the y-axis value.

rationales.derivation: From xy=6 conclude y>0 for both signs of x, and from xy=-12 conclude y<0 for both signs of x; this produces I,II and III,IV respectively.
rationales.misconception: Ignore the sign of the divisor x when deducing the sign of y=k/x.
